name: erp-dashboard-sync
description: Sync JS/CSS files between VS Code workspace and APplus ERP dashboard

commands.title: ERP Dashboard Sync: Reload From ERP
ERP Dashboard Sync: Set Credentials (Secret Storage)
ERP Dashboard Sync: Clear Credentials (Secret Storage)
ERP Dashboard Sync: Reset Version Prompt State

erpDashboardSync.dbFetchJsonUrl.description: ERP endpoint for dbFetchJSON. SQL is appended as query parameter 'sql'.

erpDashboardSync.xmlUpdateOfflineSoapUrl.description: ERP SOAP endpoint for xmlUpdateOffline (SOAP 1.2). Both .../utils.asmx and .../utils.asmx/xmlUpdateOffline are supported.

erpDashboardSync.verboseLogging.description: Write verbose debug logs to the output channel, including SQL statements, SOAP payloads and raw ERP responses. Keep disabled for normal use.

erpDashboardSync.tlsAllowInsecure.description: Allow HTTPS connections with invalid/self-signed certificates. Use only in trusted internal environments.

erpDashboardSync.authMode.description: Authentication mode used for ERP requests.

erpDashboardSync.authUsername.description: Username for NTLM authentication (fallback, if no Secret Storage credentials exist).

erpDashboardSync.authPassword.description: Password fallback for NTLM authentication. Prefer command 'Set Credentials (Secret Storage)' instead of plaintext settings.

erpDashboardSync.authDomain.description: Domain for NTLM authentication (fallback, if no Secret Storage credentials exist).

erpDashboardSync.authWorkstation.description: Workstation for NTLM authentication (fallback, if no Secret Storage credentials exist).

erpDashboardSync.autoSyncOnSave.description: Automatically write managed JS/CSS changes back to ERP on file save.

erpDashboardSync.reloadOnStartup.description: If a dashboard is already linked in the workspace, offer or perform a reload from ERP when VS Code starts.

erpDashboardSync.reloadOnStartupPrompt.description: Show a short confirmation before the startup reload. If disabled, the reload runs automatically.

erpDashboardSync.configFileName.description: Workspace file storing the context type, workspace identifier, optional Flow title and Flow version state.

erpDashboardSync.indexFileName.description: Workspace file mapping generated files to ERP rows and fields for Quickview and Flow.

erpDashboardSync.generatedRootDir.description: Folder where generated Quickview and Flow workspace files are stored.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
